## Bayes

- A Shiny app to explore the beta distribution is [here](https://carlislerainey.shinyapps.io/shiny-beta/).
- An R script to understand your prior is [here](https://gist.github.com/carlislerainey/45414e0d9f22e4e1960449402e6a8048).
- A R script to plot **all** our priors (and then posteriors) is [here](https://gist.github.com/carlislerainey/155e2fee1c01620736120c9a8bbccd6d).
- An R script to plot your posterior is [here](https://gist.github.com/carlislerainey/5064ecde24ea764817da73b037e7a18b).

## Rejection

- An R script to illustrate the rejection algorithm via a weird example is [here](https://gist.github.com/carlislerainey/813b09bce0a9f1d8cc688d3217abb700)
